findings.title: No test asserts user is forwarded to owner filter
findings.problem: The new restriction only applies when the authenticated user reaches _build_list_filters via the router and list_schedulers. Router tests patch the service and never assert kwargs['user']; the new service tests call _build_list_filters directly, and no test executes list_schedulers itself. Regression gap.
findings.impact: Trigger is narrow: a future refactor dropping user= at schedulers.py:78 or scheduler_settings_service.py:541-543 would silently re-expose other members' personal rows while all tests pass. No behavior consequence today; the forwarding is correct at HEAD.
findings.recommendation: In tests/codemie/rest_api/routers/test_schedulers.py assert the mocked list_schedulers receives user=<authenticated user>; optionally add a list_schedulers test with patched engine asserting the executed SQL contains 's.user_id = :caller_id' for a non-admin with owner_type=None.

fix.change: Added tests asserting router forwards authenticated user to list_schedulers and service forwards it to _build_list_filters
